post.summary: Creates a one-time use URL to log in member to ClientPortal
post.description:
Creates a one-time use URL that allows to log in members to ClientPortal without providing additional credentials by them.
            
We assume, that when calling this endpoint you already authenticated member some other way in your own application.
            
Please take big care when using this endpoint, because you can easily introduce security flaw when not properly authorizing member.
            
As a result you will receive URL that you need to redirect your member to.
Note, that this url has short expiration time, so you should not store it and use immediately.
            
Also, if something would be wrong with the URL (like it already expired), member would be gracefully redirected to ClientPortal log in page without any error.

post.summary: Upload files for later use in other methods
post.description:
You can use this endpoint in two ways:
- Send files in standard multipart form data.
There can be only one file attached. Remember to include file name (with extension) in form part.
            
- Send file as raw bytes inside request body.
You need to include file name (with extension) inside **X-File-Name** header
            
In result you will find ID which serve as a temporary handle to uploaded file.
You can use it passing to other methods, that would require a file, but accepts only JSON payloads.
            
Note, that not all files are allowed. Only text files, images, documents (like word or excel), pdf, audio, videos.

400.description:
There was something wrong with uploaded file (like missing file name).
Check response text for the details.
